title: 同享
prompt: A distinctive circle emblem made of two balanced curved open brackets and two short horizontal equal-sign strokes nested within the circle. The elements feel like two people gathering around a shared table, equitable contributions. The circle has intentional left/right opening negative space, generous uniform weight, no currency symbols. Elegant, compact, unified, one-color mark. Do not make a bank emblem or abstract random swish.

title: 相伴
prompt: A compact interlocking loop emblem: two identical soft rounded links intersect diagonally at 45 degrees to form a single balanced square knot, clear central shared negative space. The two contributors have equal visual weight. It suggests shared responsibility and connection. Avoid infinity sign and existing payment company logos; clear topology, one color.

title: 合账
prompt: A compact open folded receipt or ledger symbol composed of two equal rounded vertical panels facing each other, subtly joined at the bottom. Central negative space forms a precise checkmark suggesting bills settled. Bold clean silhouette rather than illustrative detail, welcoming upright proportions; no letters, no numeric marks.

title: 围坐
prompt: A friendly precise abstract four-person circle around a shared central table: four identical quarter-ring segments symmetrically arranged with clean diagonal gaps, all four parts equal in area. Negative space central small rounded square. Ring segments softly rounded; must feel like community and equal sharing, no arrowheads, no generic piechart or fourpetal flower.
